achievements.title: AI Preneur '26 - Best Use of AI
achievements.description: Won Best Use of AI at AI Preneur '26 with TeachBack - a voice-first learning platform where students teach an AI listener and get interrupted by clarifying questions. Real-time STT + LLM + TTS pipeline with multi-dimensional evaluation (clarity, structure, coverage).
highlights: Built voice-first teaching loop: voice in → Deepgram STT → Groq LLM → ElevenLabs TTS → voice out
Real-time WebSocket dialogue via Django Channels with sub-second interruption latency
Multi-dimensional evaluation engine scoring clarity, structure, and coverage of explanations
Full-stack production system: React 19 SPA + Django 5.2 + PostgreSQL + Redis + Celery
Judged Best Use of AI for the integration depth across STT, LLM, and TTS in a real product

achievements.title: NASA Space Apps Challenge - Karachi
achievements.description: Secured second place in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2025 Karachi Local Event with Skyntel - an interactive weather app featuring AI query support, personalized alerts, email subscriptions, and live community reports.
highlights: Built full-stack weather application with Django REST Framework backend
Integrated Groq AI for intelligent weather queries
Implemented Celery automation and Redis caching for performance
Deployed using Docker and Nginx reverse proxy
Presented innovative solution to judges and competed against local teams
